notes.title: 01/21 Issues solved with 32 bit OS / Achievement pop-ups / Colors change
notes.content:
Hello,

I made a quick update that should have solved the following issues:

- Unable to launch the game on 32bit OS
- Achievement pop-ups are not displayed properly
- Sometimes the color of the cat is not the same that the area he goes through

Since I dont have the proper PC to make some test, I'm not 100% sure those issues are solved, but it should be !

If you still see some issues, please don't hesitate to post a message on the forum !

Thank you for your comprehension, and good luck in your quest to find Zag's answer !
